findings.passage: I believe firmly in the Second Amendment, and I’ve even attended NRA events because I respect responsible gun ownership. At the same time, firearms should not be as easy to access as they are today. We can protect constitutional rights while still putting common‑sense safeguards in place to keep guns out of the wrong hands. To me, background checks, safe storage expectations, and reasonable limits aren’t threats to freedom, They’re basic steps to keep our communities safe.
findings.note: Gun Rights section of his campaign Issues page. He says he supports the Second Amendment and responsible ownership, says guns should be harder to get than now, and names background checks, safe storage expectations and reasonable limits as steps he sees as compatible with freedom. Page is undated.
